scope: Small nonrandomized fixtures on one subscription account setup. These are historical observations, not forecasts, universal model rankings, or reproducible public account access.
privacy: Raw prompts, answers, account data, login state, logs, session IDs, task IDs and local paths are withheld. Only aggregate counters are included.

matchedLogTask.fixture: 1200 synthetic JSONL rows; deterministic error-count answer
matchedLogTask.nativeCounterDefinition: Claude logical input includes fresh input, cache writes and cache reads.

cacheObservations.scope: One repeated log fixture. Cached reads remain part of logical input; provider quota and billing treatment can differ.

tinyTaskDelegation.scope: One tiny supplied-code review per arm. Delegation overhead was substantial; this does not estimate long-workflow efficiency.

historicalWorkerCaveat: Representative provider checks had different native counter schemas and startup conditions. The Grok row received a research sign-up gate before its validation fix, so it is not a successful research-quality result. Browser token usage was unavailable.

managedHeadMarkerFixture.scope: One read-only marker/checkpoint integration fixture; not a heavy-coding throughput benchmark.

billingCaveats: No reduction in a fixed subscription invoice was measured.
Logical input reduction, cached reads, quota consumption and API-equivalent estimates are different quantities.
No monthly savings, extra-chat allowance, reliability percentage or universal quality improvement is established.
Coordinator counters and worker counters must be reported separately and both counted when comparing delegated work.
